Publish a component to your organization's registry, where every project of the organization can
install it.

A bundle directory holds:
  component.json           the definition to publish (required)
  module.wasm              the module; or, in a crate, what 'voidhash test' built into target/voidhash/
  panel.wasm               its editor panel module, which a module that declares a panel needs
  icon.(png|svg|webp)      optional
  thumbnails/<state>.png   optional, one per preview state (png, jpg or webp)
  README.md, agent.md      optional

With --from-project, a ready version of one of the project's own components is published instead.
The server runs every publish check.

Usage:
  voidhash registry publish [path] [flags]

Arguments:
  path  A bundle directory with component.json (the current directory by default)

Flags:
      --category <category>  Editor category (with --from-project)
      --from-project <<slug>@<version>>
                             Publish a ready project component version instead, as <slug>@<version>
  -h, --help                 Show help for this command
      --json                 Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --name <name>          Registry name (with --from-project; defaults to the slug)
      --project <project>    Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default:
                             this directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet                Print only ids, one per line
      --title <title>        Display title (with --from-project)
      --version <version>    Semantic version to publish a project component as (with
                             --from-project)

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash registry publish
  voidhash registry publish ./wheel-picker --project acme/app
  voidhash registry publish --from-project plan-picker@3 --version 1.0.0
